brands， 空格处要填和 a wide 一起能具有 “选择面广” 的含义的 selection。 顺便了解一下， type 意为

questions.stem: Cashiers usually spend most of their time on their feet， which can be very ______ .
questions.tag: 形容词词形
questions.text:
空格是 be 动词的表语及副词 very 修饰的位置， 需要选形容词。 因此要在动词 tire 的过去分词 tired
和现在分词 tiring 中选一个， 收银员站着工作是导致疲劳的原因， 而不是疲劳的状态， 因此要填 tiring。
答案 （B）

on one’s feet 站立着
收银员大部分时间都站着工作， 这是很累人的。

questions.stem: Auctions are proving to be ______ exciting and effective for both buyers and sellers.
questions.tag: 副词词汇
questions.text:
空格处是需要修饰形容词 exciting 和 effective 的副词的位置。 选项都是副词， 所以要了解句子内容。
内容是拍卖对购买者和销售者来说都是同时有趣而有效的， 因此空格处填上下文中意为 “同时地” 的
simultaneously 合适。 答案 （C）
questions.extra:
auction 拍卖 prove 证明是； 证明； 证实 financially 财政上， 金融上
carefully 小心谨慎地； 警惕地； 仔细地； 周密地 simultaneously 同时地
extraneously 外来地； 无关地
拍卖被证明是对购买者和销售者都同时有趣而有效的好方法。

questions.stem: Several leading oil companies have been trying to gain access to the rights ______ crude oil in the oil fields in South America.
questions.tag: 动词词形
questions.text:
空格处需要非限定动词， 该非限定动词要接意为 “原油” 的 crude oil 为宾语， 同时起到修饰名词
rights 的作用， 因此空格处要填 to produce。 一句话里不能同时有两个动词， 因此 produce 是错误选项；
名词也不能接其他名词为宾语， 因此 production 也是错误选项。 答案 （A）
questions.extra:
leading 最重要的； 卓著的； 首位的， 居前的

crude oil 原油
几家主要的油田开发企业一直在努力争取在南美油田生产原油的权利。

questions.stem: Under the revised law， every guest should pay a special state sales tax ______ all alcoholic beverages.
questions.tag: 介词
questions.text:
空格前提到特别的销售税， 空格后提到酒类产品， 因此空格处要填能构成对所有酒类产品征收的税金
的介词 on。 这里的介词 on 通过 “接触” 的含义意指税金和征收税金的对象的关系， 表示产生效果/ 影响
的方向的对象， 要了解这一点。 答案 （A）
questions.extra:
revised 经过改正/ 修正/ 修改/ 修订的 sales tax 销售税， 营业税， 消费税
alcoholic beverage 酒精饮料
根据修改后的法律， 所有顾客都要向州缴纳酒类产品特别消费税。

questions.stem: Economists and financial market analysts need to pinpoint the exact cause of the global financial crisis ______ find some working solutions.
questions.tag: 副词短语
questions.text:
空格后是短语， 而不是句子， 首先排除连接词 in order that 和 provided that。 空格前的内容是需要说
明世界金融危机的准确原因， 空格后的内容是寻找解决办法， 所以空格处要填意为 “目的/ 意图” 的副词
短语。 因此空格处填表目的/ 意图的副词短语 so as to 合适。 答案 （C）
questions.extra:
pinpoint 确认； 准确解释/ 说明； 精确地确定/ 指明……的位置
so as to Vr 以便， 以致， 为了 provided that 如果； 假如； 只要
经济学家和金融市场分析家需要说明世界金融危机的准确原因， 以找到一些解决方法。

questions.stem: Astronomical studies in the past few decades have shown that the gravity of the moon is about 20 percent of ______ of the Earth.
questions.tag: 代词 that
questions.text:
包括空格的从句的内容是比较月球的重力和地球的重力。 空格处要填意为 “地球的重力” 的代词。 it
是指代前面提及的 the gravity 的代词， 在已经知道是月球的重力的情况下， it 被 the Earth 修饰很不自然；
one 能被 gravity 修饰， 但是意为几个中不特定的一个， 也不能被 of the Earth 这样具体、 限定性的内容修
饰。 因此， that 是唯一能被介词短语修饰、 指代 gravity 的代词。 答案 （C）
questions.extra:
astronomical 极其巨大的， 天文数字的； 天文学的； 天体的
past 过去； 过去的； 以前的 decade 十年， 十年期 gravity 重力； 地球引力
过去数十年的天文学研究显示， 月球的重力大约是地球的重力的 20% 。

questions.stem: The company decided ______ 10% of its workforce as a part of a restructuring effort due to slow demand for new yachts.

questions.extra:
restructuring 改组； 重新组织； 调整 slow demand 放缓的需求
因为对新的游艇的需求下降， 作为公司结构调整的一环， 公司决定裁员 10% 。

questions.stem: This museum is one of the oldest institutions in the United States dedicated to ______ the nation's railroad history.

questions.text:

要填动名 词 preserving， 而 不能 填 动词 原 形。 顺 便 学习 一 些 to 后 面 接动 名 词 的 表 达 方 式， 如 be
committed/ decided/ devoted to V-ing， look forward to V-ing， object to V-ing， be opposed to V-ing， be
used to V-ing， be accustomed to V-ing。 答案 （C）
questions.extra:
be dedicated to 奉献给……， 献身于…… preserve 保护； 保存； 维护
该博物馆是专门保存美国铁路历史的美国最悠久的机构之一。

questions.stem: Voters should carefully check ______ candidate has the capacity to protect and take responsibility for national security and interest.
questions.tag: 关系形容词以及名词性从句连接词
questions.text:

置。 candidate 是可数名词单数形式， 没有不定冠词或定冠词之类的限定词， 空格处要填起限定词作用、

capacity 能力； 才能 take responsibility for 对……负责
选民们要慎重地了解候选人是否具有维护国家安全和国家利益并为之负责的能力。

questions.stem: Most of the local businesses in Syracuse usually give a ______ of their sales to the municipal orphanage.

企业将公司销售额的一部分捐赠给市孤儿院， 根据上下文名词 percentage 最合适。 答案 （B）

questions.extra:
analyst 分析者； 分析家 strongly 强烈地； 强有力地 copper mine 铜矿

questions.stem: Bella Telecom， which announced its plan to ______ with Ciao， Inc. ， the largest domestic software development company， will increase its influence in the telecommunication industry.

的影响力。 看这样的句子内容， 要在 acquire 和 merge 两者之中选择一个。 merge 是和介词 with 一起使

付； 与……打交道”， 是意思不符的错误选项。 答案 （C）
questions.extra:

questions.stem: Drug prices have been rising at ______ an unprecedented rate that people are worried that the drugs they need will be beyond their ability to purchase.

questions.text:
考虑到语序 “such + 不定冠词 + 形容词 + 名词”， 即形容词前面是冠词的语序特点， 空格处要填

容词 +名词” 里是修饰后面的形容词的副词， 而不是不定冠词， 要记住这一点。 答案 （D）

In recent times， the human race has made many technological advances to make our lives more
comfortable and enjoyable. However， technology isn't always a good thing. The latest findings
from the government indicate that we are perhaps more unhealthy than ever before， with a
staggering 40% of the population declared as overweight or obese. As such， the government
launched its Fighting Fit campaign last December to encourage people to get off of their sofas and
to exercise more. Early signs indicate that Fighting Fit has been a success so far.
164 Frontline Footwear has been one of the major beneficiaries of this campaign. 166 Frontline is a
Japanese company that specializes in the production of hiking boots. As more and more people
have risen from their sofas and started to explore the great outdoors， the need for its products has
increased dramatically. “ We have seen a huge surge in sales since this campaign kicked off，＂
said 165 Sales Director Kobi Yamamoto. “ Sales for the month of March almost tripled when
compared to the same month last year. ”
167 The Frontline brand is well known amongst the hiking community for using high-quality cow
leather in their products. This ensures that the boots are very durable. They also use the patented
GripLock Ⓒ system on their soles， which allows for maximum grip， something essential to hikers
and climbers.
There are many brands of hiking boots on the market. So why exactly is the Frontline model
proving so popular “We are able to offer quality products at bargain prices，” Yamamoto said.
“In these tough economic times， people are very money conscious. We source our leather and
other materials from suppliers in China. We buy in huge quantities， so we are able to get the best
deals. As such， we are able to offer lower prices than our competitors when our shoes make it on
to the shelves. ”
So what does Frontline plan to do with the increased profits “We plan to set up overseas branches
and to export our products abroad to foreign markets，” said Mr. Yamamoto. “ We have noticed
that more and more people in Europe and North America want to become healthier. We believe
that our products can help them do that. Hiking is an excellent way to keep fit. ”
After so much success in Japan， few would doubt the company's potential to dominate foreign
markets for years to come.

Mountaineering Monthly
April
In recent times， the human race has made many technological advances to make our lives more
comfortable and enjoyable. However， technology isn't always a good thing. The latest findings from
the government indicate that we are perhaps more unhealthy than ever before， with a staggering
40% of the population declared as overweight or obese. As such， the government launched its
Fighting Fit campaign last December to encourage people to get off of their sofas and to exercise
more. Early signs indicate that Fighting Fit has been a success so far.
Frontline Footwear has been one of the major beneficiaries of this campaign. Frontline is a Japanese
company that specializes in the production of hiking boots. As more and more people have risen
from their sofas and started to explore the great outdoors， the need for its products has increased
dramatically. “We have seen a huge surge in sales since this campaign kicked off，” said Sales
Director Kobi Yamamoto. “Sales for the month of March almost tripled when compared to the same
month last year. ”
The Frontline brand is well known amongst the hiking community for using high-quality cow leather in
their products. This ensures that the boots are very durable. They also use the patented GripLock ⓒ
system on their soles， which allows for maximum grip， something essential to hikers and climbers.
There are many brands of hiking boots on the market. So why exactly is the Frontline model proving
so popular “We are able to offer quality products at bargain prices，” Yamamoto said. “ In these
tough economic times， people are very money conscious. We source our leather and other materials
from suppliers in China. We buy in huge quantities， so we are able to get the best deals. As such，
we are able to offer lower prices than our competitors when our shoes make it on to the shelves. ”
So what does Frontline plan to do with the increased profits “We plan to set up overseas branches
and to export our products abroad to foreign markets，” said Mr. Yamamoto. “We have noticed that
more and more people in Europe and North America want to become healthier. We believe that our
products can help them do that. Hiking is an excellent way to keep fit. ”
After so much success in Japan， few would doubt the company's potential to dominate foreign
markets for years to come.
